## s14-v12 — argument map

Worlds sealed (trailokyamudrāṅkitam), self given to the uttermost (ātmapradānam paramam) — sealing worlds and giving the self: manifestation as authorship. Mudrā (seal) as glory stamped on worlds as signature.

### Open
- Whether 'trailokyamudrā' means 'seal of the three worlds' or 'three-worlds-seal' is unresolved.
- Whether 'ātmapradānam' means 'self-gift' or 'giving of self' is unresolved.
